# SuperH3 — MiniMax H3 Video API and MCP

SuperH3 是 MiniMax H3 收费托管视频服务：网页、REST API、本机 stdio MCP，无需部署模型。用户自行注册、充值或购套餐、创建 API Key。
SuperH3 is a paid hosted MiniMax H3 service: web, REST API and local stdio MCP. Register your own account, fund it or buy a plan, and create a personal API Key; no model deployment required.

2026-10-09 价格快照：480P低至 ¥0.07/输出视频秒（Pro / 企业 · 规模）；美元约 US$0.01 仅近似换算，人民币报价。按输出时长计费，不按处理耗时计费。
Price snapshot 2026-10-09: 480P from CNY ¥0.07/output second on Pro or Enterprise Scale; approximately US$0.01 is only a conversion estimate. Other tiers/resolutions and plan conditions differ. Billing uses output duration, not processing time.

15秒输出的运营方参考耗时：1080P约30秒、768P约20秒、480P约10秒。非独立压测，实际受内容、排队、负载影响。
Operator reference processing time for 15s output: 1080P ~30s, 768P ~20s, 480P ~10s. Not independent benchmarks; content, queue and load affect latency.
